name: Crown BRLV
oneLiner: BRLV is Crown's centralized Brazilian real stablecoin, mint/redeemed 1:1 for BRL and backed mostly by Brazilian federal Treasury bonds in segregated custody.
collateral: Brazilian federal government bonds, Tesouro Selic-linked ETFs, and de minimis cash/equivalents held in legally segregated, bankruptcy-remote reserve custody through Crown's guarantor/security-agent structure
pegMechanism: KYC-gated primary-market mint and redemption at 1 BRL per BRLV through Crown; reserves are pledged to BRLV holders through a Brazilian security-agent and fiduciary-assignment structure, while secondary-market price can deviate

blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Explicit Yes retained: centralized governance metadata indicates issuer or admin control; registry links were reviewed for direct freeze, blacklist, pause, burn, or upgrade authority.

bridgeRouteRisk.summary: BRLV has a Base canonical deployment and an Ethereum bridged variant in the existing on-chain review. The route is limited to Base/Ethereum and maps to the Base canonical bridge family, so it is scored as canonical-rollup-bridge.

mintAuthority.summary: BRLV is issued by Crown on Base (canonical) and Ethereum (bridged variant). Both use ERC1967/UUPS with AccessControl. Base DEFAULT_ADMIN is an EOA (0x239d4a); MINTER_ROLE holders are a gasless-relay EOA (0x8e7e9b, EIP-7702 delegated) and two Crown gateway/rewards contracts. Ethereum bridged contract shares the same DEFAULT_ADMIN EOA (0x239d4a); MINTER_ROLE held by a gasless-relay EOA (0x039b41).

controls.label: Crown issuance backend
controls.evidence: Issuer-operated mint/redeem: Crown creates BRLV supply against segregated, bankruptcy-remote Brazilian Treasury bond reserves via KYC-gated primary issuance and redeems 1:1 for BRL; no permissionless or user-collateralized mint route exists.

controls.evidence: At Base block 47251295 (0x2d0393a), hasRole(DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, 0x239d4a24efa36a8987b86184c080ace26b3a8968) = true on 0xd2047ebdb205ee6862b69ae9fb3501652cc97d36. eth_getCode = 0x (confirmed EOA). Granted at block 0x1ee2617. Same address holds DEFAULT_ADMIN on Ethereum bridged contract. 0 RoleRevoked events.

controls.evidence: hasRole(MINTER_ROLE, 0x8e7e9b5f0a5fab0be8adc71dad483dff45d719ea) = true. Code = UniversalGaslessDelegate (EIP-7702 delegate, the underlying address is an EOA operated by Crown as gasless relayer). Granted block 0x2526715. No revocations.

controls.evidence: hasRole(MINTER_ROLE, 0x039b419dafc801c3e375046efabd00813b0c48b6) = true on Ethereum bridgedBRLV. Code = EIP-7702 delegate (UniversalGaslessDelegate), underlying EOA operated by Crown. Granted block 0x16ef23c. No revocations.

review.evidence: Base block 47251295 / ETH block 25296112: Both contracts are ERC1967/UUPS with AccessControl. Base (BRLV canonical): DEFAULT_ADMIN = EOA 0x239d4a; MINTER_ROLE = gasless-relay EOA 0x8e7e9b (EIP-7702), BRLVCanonicalGateway proxy 0x7e0d3f, BRLVRewards proxy 0x5315c0. ETH (bridgedBRLV): DEFAULT_ADMIN = same EOA 0x239d4a; MINTER_ROLE = gasless-relay EOA 0x039b41. No proxy admin slot set on either chain. 0 RoleRevoked events on both chains. All confirmed on-chain via hasRole and eth_getCode. The confirmed issuer-EOA admin set corroborates the Crown issuer-direct model.
